zh.title: 法國國防部稱美方航艦彈射策略轉變不影響新航艦電磁彈射系統
zh.summary: 法國國防部表示美航艦策略調整不影響新航艦電磁彈射器進度
body: 法國武裝部隊部表示，美國擬將未來航空母艦彈射系統改回蒸汽系統的決定，不會對法國下一代航空母艦規劃的電磁彈射系統（EMALS）構成風險。法國國防部於2026年8月15日向法新社發布聲明指出，針對法國新一代航空母艦「法國自由號」的電磁彈射系統製造，以及未來數十年的維護作業，目前未發現任何特定的技術或工業風險。
此項評估源於美國總統川普於2026年8月13日簽署的行政備忘錄，指示美國國防部在60天內提出計畫，將第四艘福特級航空母艦「多里斯·米勒號」（USS Doris Miller）上的電磁彈射器與先進武器升降機替換為蒸汽與液壓系統。不過，美方備忘錄並未改變前三艘福特級航艦（福特號、甘迺迪號與企業號）配備電磁彈射器的既有配置，相關生產與維護供應鏈仍保持運作。
法國籌建中的核動力航空母艦「法國自由號」（France Libre，前稱PANG）規劃配備三條EMALS彈射軌道與先進攔截裝置（AAG），預計於2038年服役並接替「戴高樂號」。美國海軍先前已於2026年2月與3月分別授予通用原子公司（General Atomics）4,335萬美元與2,340萬美元合約，用以推進法國航艦配置的關鍵設計審查，並採購長交期材料與技術資料。
法國國防採購局（DGA）正與美方團隊維持對話並進行評估。為防範長期營運成本與技術依賴，法國國會已於2026年軍事計畫法更新案中通過修正案，啟動本土電磁彈射系統的可行性研究。該研究旨在評估建立本土技術能力的可行性與成本，為未來需求或潛在第二艘航艦提供備用替代方案。

en.title: France Says US Carrier EMALS Reversal Poses No Risk to New Aircraft Carrier
en.summary: French Ministry of the Armed Forces confirms US carrier catapult changes pose no risk to France Libre.
body: France's Ministry of the Armed Forces has stated that US President Donald Trump's decision to return to steam catapults on a future US Navy aircraft carrier poses no risk to the electromagnetic launch systems planned for France's next-generation aircraft carrier. In a statement issued on August 15, 2026, the ministry confirmed that no technical or industrial risks have been identified regarding the manufacturing and long-term maintenance of the catapult systems for France Libre.

The clarification follows an August 13, 2026 presidential memorandum in which Trump directed the US Department of Defense to formulate a plan within 60 days to replace the Electromagnetic Aircraft Launch System (EMALS) on the fourth Gerald R. Ford-class carrier, USS Doris Miller, with steam catapults. The French ministry noted that the first three Gerald R. Ford-class carriers retain their EMALS equipment, ensuring that the associated industrial supply chain and maintenance infrastructure remain active.

France Libre, previously designated as the Porte-Avions de Nouvelle Génération (PANG), is a nuclear-powered aircraft carrier designed around three EMALS launch tracks and an Advanced Arresting Gear (AAG) system. Scheduled to replace Charles de Gaulle in 2038, the project continues to progress through US defense contracts. In February and March 2026, the US Navy awarded General Atomics contract modifications totaling over $66 million for design review and long-lead materials supporting the French configuration.

To mitigate potential long-term risks associated with reliance on foreign suppliers, French lawmakers adopted an amendment during the 2026 update of the military programming law requiring a feasibility study for a domestic electromagnetic catapult system. France's Direction générale de l'armement (DGA) continues consultations with US counterparts while evaluating domestic technical options to support future naval requirements.

zh.title: Heart Aerospace全電動驗證機X1完成首飛
zh.summary: Heart Aerospace全電動X1驗證機完成27分鐘試飛
body: 電動航空製造商Heart Aerospace的X1全電動驗證機於8月13日在普拉茨堡國際機場（PBG）成功完成首次飛行測試。本次飛行歷時27分鐘，試飛過程中飛機達到1,100英呎的高度，其動力系統輸出超過1兆瓦的功率。
本次試飛是在美國聯邦航空局（FAA）核發的特別適航證書實驗類別（SAC-EC）下進行，涵蓋滑行、起飛、爬升、機動與著陸等項目。X1驗證機主要用於展示適用於商業航空公司營運規模的全電動飛行技術。
Heart Aerospace目前亦在洛杉磯廠房開發30人座的ES-30混合動力區域客機。該公司計劃於2028年展開ES-30的飛行測試，並以2031年投入商業營運為目標。

en.title: Heart Aerospace Completes First Flight of X1 All-Electric Demonstrator
en.summary: Heart Aerospace completed a 27-minute test flight of its X1 electric demonstrator in Plattsburgh.
body: Heart Aerospace's X1 demonstrator aircraft completed a 27-minute test flight at Plattsburgh International Airport (PBG) on August 13. During the test, the all-electric demonstrator reached an altitude of 1,100 feet with its propulsion system delivering over one megawatt of power.

The flight mission was conducted under a Special Airworthiness Certificate Experimental Category issued by the Federal Aviation Administration in July. The testing evaluated operational phases including taxi, takeoff, climb, maneuvering, and landing.

Heart Aerospace is also developing the 30-seat ES-30 hybrid-electric regional airliner at its facility in Los Angeles. Flight testing for the ES-30 is scheduled to begin in 2028, with commercial entry into service targeted for 2031.
